faq_heading: Homes near Lena Shaw Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Lena Shaw Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Lena Shaw Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Lena Shaw Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Lena Shaw Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 100 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,155,000, townhomes $620,000, condos $439,900. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Lena Shaw Elementary?
faq.a: For the 100 homes that sold within 1 km of Lena Shaw Elementary, the median time on the market was 29 days and the median sale was 96.1% of list; 7% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Lena Shaw Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.1 km north-west), Hjorth Road Elementary (1.3 km north-east) and Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (1.3 km north).

Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Lena Shaw Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Lena Shaw Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Lena Shaw Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Lena Shaw Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 100 homes sold within 1 km of Lena Shaw Elementary: 9 houses, 18 townhomes and 73 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $439,900.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Lena Shaw Elementary

35 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Lena Shaw Elementary in a straight line (24 elementary, 10 secondary, 1 other; 2 independent). The closest is Our Lady of Good Counsel, 1.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Green Timbers Elementary, 2.4 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Honour Secondary School (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (1.4 km). Other elementary schools close by: Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.1 km north-west), Hjorth Road Elementary (1.3 km north-east), Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (1.3 km north), Simon Cunningham Elementary (1.4 km south), Bonaccord Elementary (1.6 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Our Lady of Good Counsel, 1.1 km north-west of Lena Shaw Elementary.
